plugins.name: datagriff-skills
plugins.description: All dataGriff skills as one bundle, chaining requirements to specs to CI gates: requirements gathering, Gherkin authoring, Cucumber.js automation, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, ODCS data contracts, datacontract-cli, Microcks mocking and contract testing, plus work breakdown and agent-ready repo optimization. The plugin root is the repo itself, so its skills/ directory is the plugin's skills - no duplication, and new skills ship automatically.
